rules.law_name: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.title: Boston rent stabilization authorization bill
rules.requirement: This bill would authorize the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The document does not state the rent cap, covered housing, exemptions, or operative tenant rights.

coverage.summary: The page states only that the bill concerns authorization for the city of Boston; covered buildings or tenancies are not stated.

rules.interaction: The page describes a state legislative petition, with local approval received, to authorize Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.

rules.title: Boston tenant eviction protections authorization bill
rules.requirement: This bill would authorize the city of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The document does not state the specific eviction grounds, procedures, exemptions, or remedies.
